prompts.title: 产品
prompts.subtitle: 把想法做成产品
prompts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept / ads-marketing. Asset type: category overview cover interior for a Chinese GitHub portfolio. Create ONE extra-wide 3:1 horizontal banner, ideally 2172 x 724 pixels. Image 1 is the exact mascot identity reference; Image 2 is only the 3D material/rounded typography/border visual language. Do not reuse its pose or copy its title.
Composition: warm near-white background; thin charcoal rounded inner rectangle border; generous safe margins. LEFT 44% title/subtitle in heavy rounded black typography, RIGHT 56% one mascot and colorful props. No outer desktop window, NO window titlebar, no category header outside border; code will add these. Do not write repository, other, project names, watermark or extra labels.
Mascot identity: grayscale chibi 3D collectible with swept spiky white hair and high tied topknot, gray face, glowing white eyes, white face mask, gray hoodie, gray trousers and gray sneakers. Same silhouette/identity as Image 1. No colored skin, no colored hair/clothes, no additional character. Exactly two arms and two legs, distinct hands/feet, coherent anatomy with no merged joints.
Polished friendly 3D clay/vinyl render, matte sculpted mascot, soft studio light and contact shadows, legible silhouettes. Props stay colorful. Do not crop hands, feet or hair. High polish but simple balanced composition.
Exact LEFT text, verbatim and clear: large title “产品”; subtitle “把想法做成产品”. Broad smooth accent underline beneath title in lavender. Tiny restrained colorful accent strokes around title. Color palette: lavender, sky blue, peach and lemon.
Unique interaction: Mascot stands to the right of the title in a lively three-quarter left-facing pose, leaning forward slightly with both hands pressing against a colorful oversized desktop app window on small wheels, pushing it to the right. The app is a layered soft blue and lavender rounded dashboard with a few chunky colorful application icons (chat bubble, pink planet, translation tiles) securely arranged on the platform. Both knees are slightly bent in a clear natural walking stance, two separate legs, both sneakers visible, a convincing push action; exactly two hands pressing the side edge of the app. No text on the app icons, no real logos.
